name: Tirzepatide
description: A dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) and GLP-1 receptor agonist given once weekly by subcutaneous injection. Approved as Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes and as Zepbound for chronic weight management and obstructive sleep apnoea in obesity.

systems.note: Glucose-dependent insulin secretion via GIP and GLP-1 receptors on the beta cell; the intended site of action.
Weight loss under incretin agonism is not fat-selective; lean mass falls alongside fat mass.
Transaminase elevation and hepatobiliary events appear in labelling and in the DILI literature.
Rapid weight and volume change moves the lipid panel independently of any lipid agent.

monitors.why: The direct index of the glycaemic effect the drug is given for.
Tracks the glycaemic response between A1c draws.
Pancreatitis is a labelled risk; lipase is the specific enzyme.
Read with lipase; the pair is what a pancreatic panel reports.
Hepatobiliary events are labelled; ALT is the sentinel transaminase.
Distinguishes lean-mass loss from fat loss during the weight-loss phase.
Read with lean mass to show whether the loss was fat-selective.
